attributes.action: Grant British Citizenship to Every Child Born in the United Kingdom
attributes.additional_details: Every child born within the United Kingdom should automatically acquire British citizenship at birth.No parental nationality or immigration-status requirements should apply.Children born in the UK should not be left stateless or without secure nationality rights because of their parents' circumstances.The Government should introduce the necessary legislative amendments to establish unconditional birthright citizenship.We ask Parliament to recognise that children are individuals with their own rights and identities.
attributes.background:
Petition to amend the British Nationality Act 1981
We call on the UK Government and Parliament to change the British Nationality Act 1981 to introduce unconditional birthright citizenship for every child born in the United Kingdom.
